summary.name: VictorOps (now Splunk On-Call)
summary.one_liner: VictorOps, now renamed Splunk On-Call, is an incident management and on-call alerting product for DevOps and operations teams.
use_cases: managing on-call rotations for engineering teams
giving stakeholders visibility into live incidents
summary.what_it_does: The page is a notice that VictorOps has been renamed Splunk On-Call, with a product update. It describes the product as helping developers, DevOps and operations teams manage on-call work and reduce mean time to acknowledge and restore outages. Teams receive context-rich notifications and can collaborate across functions to resolve incidents. Stakeholders can see critical incidents and the steps taken to resolve them. The page itself offers only sign-in, support and resource links and gives no further feature detail.
notable: Renamed from VictorOps to Splunk On-Call after the Splunk acquisition
Context-rich incident notifications for on-call teams
Stakeholder visibility into incident status and resolution steps
caveats: Page is mostly a rebranding notice with few product facts
Listed under 'Books' in awesome-sre, but the page itself is about the product, not the book
